mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a pickup in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2.0% indicates slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 2.5%, the combined signal indicates a tightening monetary policy with inflation concerns, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a labor market shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market shocks and stock performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent growth in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average, indicating strong consumer spending, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the economy shows resilience.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS growth is consistent, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
